segments.outcome: Cody Rhodes (c) def. Gunther via Cross Rhodes to RETAIN the Undisputed WWE Championship -- CONTROVERSIAL: Gunther's foot was under the bottom rope when ref Dan Engler counted (rope-break missed; confirmed on broadcast). Cody now 2-0 vs Gunther. Post-show: Cody acknowledged the win wasn't clean and offered the rematch. ~11:35.
segments.notes: The reassuring-dose, exactly as called -- the American hero who can't win clean/alone but won't go down; propped past merit by the institution's missed call (decline, not privilege). Gunther = the truth-teller who named 'the crumbling American dream,' correct on the merits, then denied = foreign-shadow INVERTED (Scroll 007). Cody owning the bad call + offering the rematch REDEEMS the taint (reign keeps the asterisk; his moral standing clean) -- a moral rebuttal to Gunther's narcissism/nepotism charge. Title in the OPENER = retain-coded. (We called the SHAPE/tainted-retain; guessed Orton, actual taint = ref error.)

segments.outcome: Rhea Ripley (c) def. Jade Cargill via a second Riptide to RETAIN the WWE Women's Championship -- assisted. B-Fab roped Jade's foot to break a pin; Charlotte Flair ran in, attacked Michin/B-Fab, and countered Jade's Jaded by roping Rhea's foot (the mirror). WM42 rematch. ~16:54.
segments.notes: Pick hit -- the Morrigan weathers the storm; Jade's clean build-pins were misdirection. NOT clean = CONTESTED PARITY (heels cheated first via B-Fab's rope; Charlotte's counter cancelled it; the Riptide pin was legit) -- distinct from Cody's 'propped past merit vs a clean opponent.' Third foot-on-rope of the night (the rule as the night's motif). MOTIVE UNCONFIRMED: Joe's read = Charlotte 'receipts paid' for a Jade-faction attack on Alexa Bliss (-> fracture stays open, save incidental); outlets frame the run-in as motive-ambiguous -- verify on video.

segments.outcome: Brock Lesnar def. Oba Femi (non-title) via the SEVENTH F-5, avenging his WM42 loss. Lesnar hit four consecutive F-5s early; Oba kicked out of five F-5s total and muscled out of the Kimura; one F-5 came through the announce table. ~6:21.
segments.notes: Pick hit (the flip). The triple-forging MIDDLE via WAR, not squash -- Surtr's fire prevails; Oba ELEVATED in defeat (forged by belonging in the fire), setting up the SummerSlam coronation. Joe's loose reads: Oba = a rightful equal -> the worthy adversary that drew Surtr out; Brock's 'conditional retirement' reads as a FEINT (full-time vs recurring-gatekeeper open; scarcity = the aura). Ragnarok convergence: Surtr(Brock) + Loki(Seth)'s Ragnarok army assembled across two storylines -- track convergence.

segments.outcome: Sol Ruca def. Becky Lynch (c) via the Sol Snatcher (countering Becky's second Manhandle Slam attempt) to become NEW Women's IC Champion -- CLEAN (WWE broke out pyro). Move-theft exchange: Becky's Manhandle Slam -> Sol's own Manhandle Slam -> Sol Snatcher counter. ~14:00.
segments.notes: Pick hit -- our RISKIEST call (the flip), and CLEAN. Succession rendered move-for-move: the veteran tries the successor's own move and misses; the successor proves she can wield the elder's tool then wins as herself. THESIS-KEEPER: the night's two standard-rules retains held by rules-illegitimacy, but the one SUCCESSION was clean -- the future is won cleanly; the past is maintained by taint.

segments.outcome: Roman Reigns (c) def. Jacob Fatu in Tribal Combat (no-DQ) to RETAIN the World Heavyweight Championship -- via two spears: toolbox to Fatu's previously-injured Death-Grip hand (Fatu later released the Tongan Death Grip in pain), a low blow at the kickout, a spear through a corner table, Fatu rose, second standing spear -> pin. Exposed turnbuckles. Cole: 'The Samoan Werewolf has been neutered. He's been domesticated at the hands of the still Head of the Table.' ~27:11.
segments.notes: Pick hit -- Roman retains, Fatu PROTECTED (a war through tables + multi-spear kickout, not a squash). Won CLEAN under the FAMILY's law (no-DQ; toolbox/low-blow are LEGAL -- brutal != illegitimate, 'clean even if it's not'); Tribal Combat = the family's own law outside the company's rules -> the one crown tonight with zero rules-asterisk (won by surviving). The match systematically emasculated the aitu (Death-Grip hand -> low blow -> 'neutered'), landing Roman's 'domesticate' goal.

segments.outcome: Post-match: Jey Uso placed the ula fala around Roman's neck; the MFT (Solo, Tama, Talla) were shown in the front row; Fatu stopped at the bottom of the ramp, stared down the MFT, then followed Roman up the aisle = accepts subordination. The aitu is ABSORBED into the Bloodline. Faction realignment: Roman + Usos + absorbed-Fatu = the new core; MFT remnant OUT. (Joe relayed a Cathy Kelley post-show 'Fatu accepts' spot; dialogue UNVERIFIED in outlet text.)
segments.notes: 'Loser serves' pays off as ABSORPTION, not destruction: the aitu who spent weeks 'claiming jurisdiction under the family code' is neutered -> domesticated -> folded in by his own ACCEPTANCE = the most complete containment. Absorption was the weekend's throughline on BOTH cards (AAA: Raiders/Pagano/Omos; WWE: Fatu).
